prompt: Locked-off tripod product beauty shot of a finished white laundry-sink cabinet with a stainless steel drop-in sink and brushed-nickel pull-down faucet on the left, a dark front-load washer and dryer on the right, in a bright styled modern laundry room. The CAMERA DOES NOT MOVE — no push-in, no zoom, no pan; hold the full wide establishing framing so the whole cabinet, sink, faucet and washer/dryer stay fully in frame the entire time. The scene is calm and still with only the faintest life — soft daylight and a gentle shimmer on the stainless steel. Photoreal, clean and crisp, no people, no on-screen text, no captions, no logos.
